unemployment_rate_monthly_sa.name: 完全失業率（月次・季節調整値）
unemployment_rate_monthly_sa.notes: Labour Force Survey basic tabulation. 1953-01..1973-12 excludes Okinawa (Okinawa included from 1972-07 in raw data; SA computed on excl-Okinawa raw to 1972-06). 1953-01..03 affected by sample redesign (parenthesised in source). 2011-03..08 are supplementary estimates (<>). Benchmark population switched every 5 years from 1982 (ratios not retro-adjusted). Seasonal adjustment X-12-ARIMA, revised back 10 years each January. Latest month in file: 2026-09.

unemployment_rate_annual.name: 完全失業率（年平均）
unemployment_rate_annual.notes: JILPT compilation of LFS annual averages (時系列接続用数値 from 1953). 1952 and earlier: 14+ population, from 日本長期統計総覧; unemployment definition changed 1949-05 and 1951-10. Excludes Okinawa through 1972. 2011 = supplementary estimate.

jobs_to_applicants_ratio_annual_jil.name: 有効求人倍率（年平均、パート含む、新規学卒除く）
jobs_to_applicants_ratio_annual_jil.notes: 1963+ from MHLW 一般職業紹介状況; 1952-1962 computed by JILPT from 労働省『戦後の労働市場』 annual totals (rounded here to 2dp) — not strictly comparable. Okinawa from 1973.

new_jobs_ratio_monthly_sa.name: 新規求人倍率（月次・季節調整値、パートタイムを含む一般、新規学卒者を除く）
new_jobs_ratio_monthly_sa.notes: Seasonal adjustment X-12-ARIMA; SA values through 2025-12 revised with new seasonal factors at Jan-2026 release. Okinawa included from 1973. Covers public employment security offices (Hello Work) only. Latest: 2026-09.

new_jobs_ratio_annual.name: 新規求人倍率（年平均・原数値、パート含む）
new_jobs_ratio_annual.notes: Annual average of unadjusted monthly ratios (年平均 column).

jobs_to_applicants_ratio_monthly_sa.name: 有効求人倍率（月次・季節調整値、パートタイムを含む一般、新規学卒者を除く）
jobs_to_applicants_ratio_monthly_sa.notes: Seasonal adjustment X-12-ARIMA; SA values through 2025-12 revised with new seasonal factors at Jan-2026 release. Okinawa included from 1973. Covers public employment security offices (Hello Work) only. Latest: 2026-09.

jobs_to_applicants_ratio_annual.name: 有効求人倍率（年平均・原数値、パート含む）
jobs_to_applicants_ratio_annual.notes: Annual average of unadjusted monthly ratios (年平均 column).

vacancy_rate_quarterly_sa.name: 欠員率（季節調整値）
vacancy_rate_quarterly_sa.notes: JILPT: 欠員率 = (有効求人数−就職件数)/(有効求人数−就職件数+雇用者数), quarterly averages of monthly SA values. 1967Q1–2025Q2.

employee_unemployment_rate_quarterly_sa.name: 雇用失業率（季節調整値）
employee_unemployment_rate_quarterly_sa.notes: JILPT: 雇用失業率 = 完全失業者/(雇用者+完全失業者) (employee-based, not the headline rate). 1967Q1–2025Q2.

structural_unemployment_rate_quarterly.name: 均衡失業率（構造的・摩擦的失業率）
structural_unemployment_rate_quarterly.notes: JILPT UV-analysis estimates; model-dependent (β estimated on stable sub-periods). 需要不足失業率 = 完全失業率 − 均衡失業率.

real_wage_index_annual.name: 実質賃金指数（現金給与総額、調査産業計、年平均）
real_wage_index_annual.notes: values = 事業所規模5人以上・就業形態計 (1990–2025). by_group keys '<size>_<form>': size 5+ (1990+) / 30+ (1970+ for all; 1990+ by form); form all/general(一般労働者)/part_time. Deflator: CPI 持家の帰属家賃を除く総合. Index series are linked across sample rotations/benchmark revisions (時系列比較用). Known break: 2004-2011 Tokyo 500+ sampling irregularity corrected (2019 re-estimation); from 2019-06 full survey of 500+ establishments.

nominal_wage_index_annual.name: 名目賃金指数（現金給与総額、調査産業計、年平均）

nominal_wage_level_annual.name: 現金給与総額（月額、調査産業計、年平均）
nominal_wage_level_annual.notes: Levels (実数) as published each year; NOT linked across sample/benchmark changes, so year-on-year changes in levels can differ from the official index growth rates — use the index series for growth. 30+ from 1960 (only 1970+ requested; all kept), 5+ from 1990.

annual_total_hours_worked.name: 年間総実労働時間（月間総実労働時間×12、調査産業計）
annual_total_hours_worked.notes: Computed as monthly average 総実労働時間 ×12 (MHLW/JILPT convention). 'all' includes part-time; 'general' = 一般労働者; 'part_time' = パートタイム労働者 (by-form data from 1993/1990). Cross-check: JILPT g0501_02 shows 5+ 2024 = 1643, 2025 = 1621.

part_time_ratio_maikin.name: パートタイム労働者比率（毎勤、本月末労働者数ベース、年平均実数から算出）
part_time_ratio_maikin.notes: Computed = パートタイム労働者数/本月末労働者数 from annual-average 実数 rows; official index file also carries パートタイム労働者比率.

shunto_wage_increase_rate.name: 春季賃上げ率（民間主要企業、定昇込み）
shunto_wage_increase_rate.notes: Coverage: firms with capital ≥¥1bn and ≥1,000 employees with unions (to 2003: TSE/OSE 1st-section listed, capital ≥¥2bn). Simple average to 1979, weighted average from 1980. ~160 firms to 1964, ~300 from 1965 (390 in 2025). Includes 2026 (latest published by JILPT).

minimum_wage_weighted_avg.name: 地域別最低賃金 全国加重平均額（時間額）
minimum_wage_weighted_avg.notes: Hourly 2002–2026 from MHLW table (FY2017 shows 847.72 unrounded in MHLW sheet, JILPT shows 848; FY2026 1176.93 ≈ 1177). Before FY2002 minimum wages were set as daily amounts (日額, 1975–2001, from JILPT g0403) — not comparable with hourly. All 47 prefectures have regional minimum wages since FY1975. FY = revision year; new rates usually take effect Oct (FY2025/2026 several prefectures later).

minimum_wage_by_prefecture.name: 地域別最低賃金（都道府県別、時間額）
minimum_wage_by_prefecture.notes: FY2002 (平成14) – FY2026 (令和8). Effective dates in tables.minimum_wage_effective_dates.

non_regular_share.name: 非正規の職員・従業員の割合（役員を除く雇用者に占める割合）
non_regular_share.notes: 2002–2025: LFS detailed tabulation annual average; share = 非正規/(正規+非正規) as published. 1984–2001 (by_group feb_*): LFS Special Survey, February only (computed here as 非正規/(正規+非正規) from table 9-1; source lfs_lt_9_1). BREAK at 2001/2002 (survey, month, questionnaire). 2008 and earlier 非正規 = sum of categories; 2009+ tabulated directly. 2005–2021 levels are 時系列接続用 values; ratios not adjusted. 2011 supplementary estimate.

non_regular_employees.name: 非正規の職員・従業員数

employment_rate_age_65_69.name: 就業率 65-69歳
employment_rate_age_65_69.notes: LFS annual average. 65-69 and 70-74 sub-groups available only for years shown (70-74/75+ split published from later years).

employment_rate_age_70_74.name: 就業率 70-74歳
employment_rate_age_70_74.notes: LFS annual average. 65-69 and 70-74 sub-groups available only for years shown (70-74/75+ split published from later years).

employment_rate_age_60_64.name: 就業率 60-64歳
employment_rate_age_60_64.notes: LFS annual average. 65-69 and 70-74 sub-groups available only for years shown (70-74/75+ split published from later years).

employment_rate_age_70plus.name: 就業率 70+歳
employment_rate_age_70plus.notes: LFS annual average. 65-69 and 70-74 sub-groups available only for years shown (70-74/75+ split published from later years).

employment_rate_age_65plus.name: 就業率 65+歳
employment_rate_age_65plus.notes: LFS annual average. 65-69 and 70-74 sub-groups available only for years shown (70-74/75+ split published from later years).

jilpt_projected_employed_total.name: 就業者数 見通し（JILPT 2024）
jilpt_projected_employed_total.notes: values = baseline scenario (成長率ベースライン・労働参加漸進); by_group = all three scenarios. 1995–2022 actual, 2025+ projected. 2040: growth 6734.0 / baseline 6375.3 / zero-growth 5767.7 万人.

nta_share_earners_le_1m.name: 1年を通じて勤務した給与所得者のうち給与100万円以下の割合
nta_share_earners_le_1m.notes: NTA private-sector wage survey; workers employed all year (excl. <1yr tenure). Bracket width 100万円 — cannot isolate 103/106/130万 thresholds. 2016–2025 累年 sheet.

foreign_workers_total.name: 外国人労働者数（各年10月末）
foreign_workers_total.notes: 2021–2025 exact from 参考-1. 2008–2020 transcribed from data labels of chart 図1-1 in mhlw_gaikoku_r7_pdf (unit 千人, rounded to thousands, then ×1000) — approximate; earlier annual releases are only on warp.ndl.go.jp (not an allowed host). Registration-based (届出) counts: excludes special permanent residents and 外交/公用. Notification became mandatory Oct 2007.

female_lfpr_by_age_mcurve.name: 女性の年齢階級別労働力人口比率（M字カーブ）
female_lfpr_by_age_mcurve.notes: LFS basic tabulation annual averages (1953–1977 values are 時系列接続用 per source notes). 65-69/70-74 sub-groups exist only from later years.

lfpr_by_age_sex_all_years.notes: Full 1968–2025 labour force participation rate by 5-year age and sex. 1973 = incl. Okinawa row.

jilpt_labor_projection_2024.notes: JILPT 2023年度版 労働力需給の推計 (press release 2024-03-11, report No.284 Aug 2024; corrigendum 2025-05-16 concerns productivity charts only). 1995–2022 = actuals (LFS), 2025–2040 = projections. Base population: IPSS 2023 projection (出生中位・死亡中位). Industry table source: jil_rouju_2024_ind (2022 actual, 2025–2040 projected). Age 65-69/70-74 breakdown of employed derived by JILPT (non-integer actuals). No newer edition found on rouju.html as of access date.

nenshu_kabe_part_survey_2021.notes: MHLW 令和3年 (Oct-2021) パートタイム・有期雇用労働者総合実態調査 個人調査 (published 2022/2023 on e-Stat). Keys per sheet = 就業形態 (計/パート/無期パート/有期パート/有期フル). t20 base = all workers of the form; t21 base = workers who adjust (=100). t16 earnings = 'income from current employment form last year', brackets incl. 90-100万, 100-110万 (contains 103万), 120-130万, 130-140万. Sources: t20 mhlw_part_2021_t20, t16 mhlw_part_2021_t16. Survey is every ~5 years; 2021 is latest found. Ratios are weighted estimates; '-' = 0/none, '*' cells flag small samples (dropped here).

nta_earnings_distribution_2016_2025.notes: 給与階級 × 性別 × 年, 1年を通じて勤務した給与所得者. Brackets: 100万円以下, 200万円以下(=100超200以下), ...

foreign_workers_by_status_2021_2025.notes: 参考-5. 専門的・技術的分野 includes 特定技能 and 技術・人文知識・国際業務.

notes: All values transcribed programmatically from official files downloaded 2026-11-25; downloaded files treated as data only.
Labor share (労働分配率) skipped per instructions.
Periods: monthly 'YYYY-MM', quarterly 'YYYY-Qn', annual 'YYYY' (calendar year unless noted; minimum wage = fiscal year of revision).
LFS: 2022-01 benchmark switched to 2020-census population; levels 2015-10..2021-12 replaced by linked values, ratios not revised.
毎勤 levels vs index: use index for growth comparisons (levels not linked).

failures.item: 7 foreign workers 2008-2020 exact counts and by status/industry before 2021
failures.reason: Older MHLW press releases removed from www.mhlw.go.jp (404) and only archived on warp.ndl.go.jp (host not allowed); not on e-Stat. Totals 2008-2020 transcribed (thousands) from chart labels in latest release; breakdowns only 2021-2025.

No official table found that tabulates the 106万 (社会保険 8.8万円/月) threshold specifically; 2021 MHLW survey gives reasons incl. '一定の労働時間を超えると…保険料' and 10万円-wide earnings brackets; NTA brackets are 100万円 wide.
Only February special-survey values exist (plus August 1999-2001, not used).
